turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: How has your blood sugar been since your last visit?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Mostly in the 120s in the morning.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Are you still taking metformin 500 mg twice daily?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Your A1c came back at 7.1 percent.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Is that better than last time?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: It is down from 7.6 percent. Keep the same dose and we will recheck in three months.
